critical.name: STAFF_TOKEN
critical.description: Pre-shared fallback authentication token for staff operations.

critical.name: COUNTER_SETUP_CODE
critical.description: One-time workstation setup code for Windows installer first-run pairing.

critical.name: AGENT_TOKEN
critical.description: Pre-shared fallback token for Windows print agent daemon.

critical.name: CRON_SECRET
critical.description: Constant-time secret protecting automated cleanup and health scheduler endpoints.

critical.name: UPI_ID
critical.description: Virtual Payment Address (VPA) for receiving direct student UPI payments.

critical.name: UPI_PAYEE_NAME
critical.description: Business payee name displayed inside student UPI apps (e.g. PrintBK HKBK).

critical.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
critical.description: Comma-separated list of trusted web origins permitted for CORS access.

critical.name: STUDENT_APP_URL
critical.description: Base URL serving the student web application.

critical.name: STAFF_APP_URL
critical.description: Base URL serving the staff counter web application.

optional.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
optional.description: Razorpay Key ID (dormant until live keys are provisioned).

optional.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET
optional.description: Razorpay Secret (dormant until live keys are provisioned).

optional.name: GITHUB_RELEASES_OWNER
optional.description: GitHub username or organization owning the public release repository.

optional.name: GITHUB_RELEASES_REPO
optional.description: GitHub public repository name hosting desktop counter installer releases.

optional.name: COUNTER_LATEST_VERSION
optional.description: Latest published desktop app version string.

optional.name: COUNTER_MIN_VERSION
optional.description: Minimum required desktop app version before mandatory update prompt.

optional.name: COUNTER_FILE_SIZE
optional.description: Human-readable size string of the desktop installer.

optional.name: COUNTER_FILE_SIZE_BYTES
optional.description: Exact byte size of the official Windows desktop installer.

optional.name: COUNTER_SHA256
optional.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hex digest of the official Windows installer.
